text: Three real, practical levers close out this chapter: spot instances, auto-termination, and right-sizing. None of them require giving anything up — they're savings available to a workload that's already been sized and understood.

Spot instances run at a steep discount in exchange for the cloud provider reclaiming them. A fault-tolerant job cluster retries lost tasks automatically — a real discount, acceptable risk. An all-purpose cluster in active use takes that same interruption much worse.

This is the single most commonly missed cost control on Databricks. A developer steps away and never returns — without auto-termination, that cluster bills all day running nothing. Every all-purpose cluster should have this configured.

Over-provisioning just in case is the same mistake Lesson 25 argued against from a performance angle. A cluster three times the size a job needs doesn't run three times faster — it just costs three times more for the same result.

Chapter 5 is complete: Photon, AQE, caching, sizing, and now real cost control. Next up, Chapter 6, Advanced Security and Governance — row and column security at scale, Delta Sharing, secrets, and compliance.
